title: Offering Yourself to God
description: A lesson on dedicating one’s whole life to God in full surrender and obedience.

cards.heading: A Life Fully Surrendered
cards.scriptureText: Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice.
cards.body: Offering yourself to God means living in full trust and surrender to Him. It is a decision that God’s will, not our own, will lead our lives.
cards.question: What area of your life do you find hardest to surrender to God?

cards.heading: Who Can Offer Themselves to God?
cards.scriptureText: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters...
cards.body: This call is specifically for true believers who belong to Christ and are ready to live for Him.
cards.question: What does full surrender look like for a believer?

cards.heading: Why Should We Dedicate Ourselves?
cards.scriptureText: You were bought at a price.
cards.body: We belong to God because He redeemed us. He is our Lord, and our lives are meant for His purpose.
cards.question: How does knowing you belong to God affect your decisions?

cards.heading: Dedicate Your Body
cards.body: Our strength, hands, feet, ears, and entire body should be used for God’s glory and service.
cards.question: How can you use your abilities more for God’s work?

cards.heading: Dedicate Your Time
cards.scriptureText: Making the most of every opportunity.
cards.body: Time is a gift from God and should be used wisely for His purpose.
cards.question: How are you currently using your time for God?

cards.heading: Dedicate Your Heart
cards.scriptureText: They gave themselves first of all to the Lord.
cards.body: True service begins with giving our heart and inner life fully to God.
cards.question: Have you truly given your heart first to the Lord?
